command: echo '[]' > output && while IFS= read -r domain; do echo "Scanning $domain..."; /root/xss-scanner-minimal/xss-scanner -d "$domain" -concurrency 3 -headless -o "temp_$(echo $domain | tr '/' '_' | tr ':' '_').json"; done < input && for file in temp_*.json; do if [ -f "$file" ]; then python3 -c "import json; data=json.load(open('$file')); merged=json.load(open('output')); merged.extend(data if isinstance(data, list) else [data]); json.dump(merged, open('output', 'w'), indent=2)"; fi; done && rm -f temp_*.json
